headline: The KSE-100 index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange crossed the 170,000 level on Wednesday, hovering at 170,235.50 at 10:40am, up 2,216.64 points or 1.32%, Business Recorder reports.
caption:
KSE-100 index 170,000 ki satah se upar!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq Wednesday ko Pakistan Stock Exchange mein khareedari jaari rahi aur subah 10:40 baje benchmark index 2,216.64 points (1.32%) izafe ke saath 170,235.50 par tha. Arif Habib Limited ki Sana Tawfik ke mutabiq khareedari zyada tar institutions, khaas taur par mutual funds, ki taraf se aa rahi hai.
